title: Lithuanian State Scholarships for Degree Studies and Research
field: All fields (priority to fields set by national education agreements)
description: State scholarships for citizens of countries with a bilateral cooperation agreement, or from a broader eligible list, to undertake master's or doctoral study, a semester of study, or a research visit at a Lithuanian higher education institution.
amount: Monthly stipend of around EUR 592 and, for degree study, coverage of tuition fees

title: Lithuanian State Scholarships for Summer Courses of Lithuanian Language and Culture
description: Scholarships covering the cost of a four-week summer course in Lithuanian language and culture at a Lithuanian university, aimed at foreign students, Baltic-studies scholars and members of the Lithuanian diaspora.
amount: Course fee, accommodation and a stipend towards living costs

title: Kaunas University of Technology (KTU) Scholarships
description: Merit scholarships and tuition reductions for international students admitted to an English-taught bachelor's or master's programme at one of Lithuania's largest technical universities.
amount: Partial to full tuition fee reduction based on academic performance

title: Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters (Lithuania-hosted programmes)
description: Fully funded, integrated master's programmes run by a consortium of universities across at least three countries, some coordinated by or including Lithuanian institutions. Students apply to the individual programme consortium.
amount: EUR 1,400 per month, full tuition, insurance and travel/installation allowances

deadlines.term: 2027 intake (deadline varies by programme, Oct 2026 - Jan 2027)
